text.what: The cold shoulder where Napa and Sonoma both run down to San Pablo Bay. Wind off the bay every afternoon, clay underfoot, and a harvest that starts weeks before the valley floor upstream.

kin.as: Grown for still wine and for sparkling base, often on the same ranch.
Who argued for this ground when Napa wanted cabernet.
